title: National Civil War Naval Museum

services.name: Exhibits & Events
services.desc: Join author and paranormal investigator Faith Serafin for a tour of the National Civil War Naval Museum. The tour features discoveries from past investigations. Tour starts at 7pm and is expected to last approximately one hour. Immerse yourself in the unique and thrilling stories that you won't find anywhere else! Tickets must be purchased in advance and are non-refundable. Children are not permitted. No tricks, just treats. Put on your costume and bring the family out for a walk through the galleries and pick up a few sweet treats along the way. Children must be accompanied by an adult. The museum will be open on Veterans Day with FREE admission for Veterans and service

blurb: Welcome to the National Civil War Naval Museum in Columbus, Georgia, where history comes alive along the scenic Chattahoochee River. This year, we proudly celebrate the 25th anniversary at our current location. Discover the remains of the warship, CSS Jackson, and explore our impressive collection of artifacts and immersive walkthrough exhibits, including replicas of the USS Hartford and the CSS Albemarle.
